name: Scarlet Witch Turbo Draw and Build HEROIC clearing
description_md:
## UPDATE - Jan 2022 (Vision Release)
Added 4
- 1 [Zone of Silence](/card/21050)
- 1 [Determination](/card/21052)
- 2 [One Way or Another](/card/22015)


Cut 2
- 1 [Heimdall](/card/06020)
- 1 [Mockingbird](/card/01083)

_There aren't a lot of flex spots in the deck to clear space for these changes but all of the additions are worth their spot. [Zone of Silence](/card/21050) is a definitive staple for any mystic deck, and [Determination](/card/21052) is strong in this deck as well because should always been cycling through a lot of cards each turn and it will just naturally get ditched along the way. [One Way or Another](/card/22015) is very strong here for its ability to help you draw your deck, but also to help set up [Clear the Area](/card/04049) and [Skilled Investigator](/card/04047)._

_These changes do put the deck total up to 42, which isn't ideal. My further cuts would probably be [Wiccan](/card/15011) and 1 [Turn the Tide](/card/15015) but both of these cards are strong enough in their own right that I don't think its worth it and the ally count starts to get on the low side. There is so much draw that you still very quickly see most of your deck so playing 42 isn't the worst thing in the world._


## Original Write Up:

I've been really excited to share this very powerful deck as I've been playing Scarlet Witch for a while. Initially I was going through scenarios on Expert, but this deck was having no issues so I stepped it up to Heroic. This deck has so far cleared the following scenarios solo:

EXPERT Rhino/Bomb Scare (1st attempt)
EXPERT Klaw/Masters of Evil(1st attempt)
EXPERT Ultro/Under Attack (1st attempt)
HEROIC 2 Risky Business/A Mess of Things (1st attempt)
HEROIC 1 Mutagen Formula/Goblin Gimmicks (2nd attempt)
HEROIC 1 Kang/Anachronauts (1st attempt)

Full Red Skull Campaign:
HEROIC 1 Crossbones (2nd attempt)
HEROIC 1 Absorbing Man (1st attempt)
HEROIC 1 Taskmaster (1st attempt)
HEROIC 1 Zola (1st attempt)
HEROIC 1 Red Skull (1st attempt)


**Deck Concept**
As always, I start deckbuilding by looking at a heroes strengths and weaknesses.
Scarlet Witch's Strengths:
Card Draw
Low cost powerful events
Very powerful first turns when compared to other heroes

Scarlet Witch's weaknesses
Low permanent upgrades/resource generation
Acceleration tokens

So, the idea with the deck was to develop something which really took advantage of her high card draw and big first turns to allow her to quickly and safely transition into a built up setup using non hero aspect/basic permanents. Double resources (and [Chaos Magic](/card/15003)) are key here - and Scarlet Witch will see them a LOT.

Once Set up the aim is to very quickly cycle through your deck taking advantage of her powerful events to win swiftly. By the midgame you should be playing at least 2 (often 3) [Hex Bolt](/card/15004) every turn.

**The Draw and Build**
[Spiritual Meditation](/card/15019), [The Sorcerer Supreme](/card/09026) and her alter ego ability give Scarlet Witch an incredible amount of draw that allow her to see so much of her deck so quickly. This means it is very easy to find specific card combinations. This deck is designed to be VERY aggressive when using that draw. You should be mulliganing away anything that isn't an extra resource/[Chaos Magic](/card/15003) or a key support/upgrade. Occasionally [Nick Fury](/card/01084) Fury can be kept - playing him off of [Chaos Magic](/card/15003) lets you draw 3 cards whilst only spending 2.

Turn 1 you should be able to develop MULTIPLE permanent upgrades/resources. I have had games where turn 1 I have brought out [Quincarrier](/card/08023), [Helicarrier](/card/01092) AND [Nick Fury](/card/01084). This is because you are drawing so many ways to draw that you WILL find your permanents, and you should have enough extra resource cards to pay for them easily.


**Allies**
Early builds of this deck ran more allies. I initially played [Lockjaw](/card/05018), [Spider-Man](/card/13019) and even [War Machine](/card/04020) to make sure The Power in All of Us was always live. However, that just turned out not to be necessary thanks to all of the card draw. I chose to only play what I believed were the strongest allies.

[Ironheart](/card/13018) and [Nick Fury](/card/01084) both help to keep the cycle up, [Heimdall](/card/06020) ([Chaos Magic](/card/15003) anyone?) and [Wiccan](/card/15011) both have strong synergy with Scarlet Witch's kit and [Mockingbird](/card/01083) is just good...

**Justice**
First and foremost this deck is actually really just a basic deck with a justice splash. I once hoped to be able to include [The Power of Justice](/card/01062) as well, but there isn't enough room or good 2+ cost Justice cards to warrant it.

I chose justice because I believe it has the 2 strongest aspect event cards: [Clear the Area](/card/04049) and [Turn the Tide](/card/15015). [Clear the Area](/card/04049) is like a mini [Hex Bolt](/card/15004) that only discarded 2 cards but hit 1 and 2 boost icons. The draw synergises with the deck's gameplan as well. [Turn the Tide](/card/15015) deals 3 damage for 1 card, with a token requirement - the card is BUSTED. Since the gameplan is to play lots of [Hex Bolt](/card/15004) which can be unpredictable and might not fully deal with a problem, having cheap ways to clean up afterwards is really nice.

[Under Surveillance](/card/06031) helps with potential acceleration tokens, and [Skilled Investigator](/card/04047) further capitalises on the thwart. 

**Conclusion**
This deck is very powerful, and it also asks you to think a lot. It won't be uncommon for you to look at a 8+ card hand and wonder if you can kill the villain that turn. The deck is good enough to win even if you do make mistakes, but if you play it perfectly it's just crazy!
